choose.when: CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_USR_AUTH_GRP_R R JOIN TB_AUTH_GRP_M G ON G.USR_GRP_CD = R.USR_GRP_CD WHERE R.USR_ID = U.USR_ID AND R.USR_GRP_CD IN #{grpCd} ) THEN 'ADMIN' ELSE 'USER' END

mapper.select: /* AuthMapper.selectLoginUser 로그인 검증용 사용자 한 건을 조회 */ SELECT U.USR_ID, U.USR_NM, U.EML_ADDR, AS ROLE, U.PWD, U.USE_YN, U.USR_LOCK_YN, U.LGIN_ERR_CNT, U.USE_ST_DT, U.USE_END_DT FROM TB_USR_M U WHERE U.USR_ID = #{usrId}

/* AuthMapper.selectUserList 전체 사용자 목록을 조회 */ SELECT U.USR_ID AS username, U.USR_NM AS name, U.EML_ADDR AS email, AS role, CASE WHEN U.USE_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE(U.USR_LOCK_YN, 'N') = 'N' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'INACTIVE' END AS status, U.FIRS_REG_DT AS createdAt, U.FINA_REG_DT AS updatedAt FROM TB_USR_M U ORDER BY U.USR_ID ASC
